description: This file contains a singleton object `VoiceWakeCommandExtractor` with a method `extractCommand` that processes input text and trigger words to extract commands based on pattern matching. It is part of a voice command recognition system within an Android app, designed to identify and extract wake commands.

classes.name: VoiceWakeCommandExtractor
classes.description: A singleton object providing functionality to extract voice wake commands from text input.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command from the provided text based on trigger words, using regex pattern matching and string cleaning to return the command or null if none found.
